verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at developers.featurebase.app that indexes markdown versions of the docs. Doc pages are served as index.md files an agent can fetch directly, and the API docs explicitly design endpoints for AI agents. missing for 10: no first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or agent-docs offering, no evidence of an llms-full.txt or bundled full-text variant, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
